title: LinkedIn Profile Search by Name
description: Find LinkedIn profiles by first and last name with company, school, job title, industry, and location filters. Best for Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns where you already know the names of decision-makers from target companies. Use when you have a list of people to find on LinkedIn — such as event attendee lists, conference speakers, or CRM contacts you want to enrich with LinkedIn data.
tips:
- firstName and lastName are REQUIRED fields.
- Use currentCompanies to narrow results to specific target companies.
- Use currentJobTitles to filter by role (e.g., 'CTO', 'VP Engineering').
- profileScraperMode: 'Short' is cheapest, 'Full + email search' includes email.
- This is ideal for ABM when you KNOW the person's name and want their LinkedIn profile.
- Generate MULTIPLE entries if searching for 3+ people, one per person.
